# BetweenTheLines™

> AI relationship analysis from your texts. Paste a conversation and get a detailed report on communication style, attachment patterns, and relationship dynamics in about 90 seconds.

BetweenTheLines™ analyzes text conversations between two people and produces a chemistry score, attachment-style profiles, green and yellow flags, and personalized insights. The basic report is free; the deep-dive report is unlocked with a one-time $4.99 purchase.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, how it works, and the input form to start an analysis.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create a free account to save reports.

## Optional

- [Privacy](/#privacy): Messages are deleted after analysis; only results are kept.
